findings.body: The file handle returned by `open()` is never closed. While the process will eventually close it on exit, the handle remains open during the entire execution of the patched entrypoint, which may run indefinitely if the entrypoint starts a long-lived process. Use a context manager to ensure it is closed immediately after reading.
findings.suggestion:
with open(ENTRYPOINT, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        source = f.read()
findings.title: Close the entrypoint file after reading

value.summary: The change adds a shim to bypass the MongoDB kernel compatibility check; it is generally sound, with one minor resource leak.
